name: Gwynedd Foodbank (Caernarfon)
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Capel Hendre. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Caernarfon Town Council Allotments
description: Gwynedd Council manages allotment sites in Caernarfon area. Plots available from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Contact council for current availability and site locations.

name: Caernarfon Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run garden in the historic town walls offering seasonal vegetables and herbs. Surplus produce shared with local residents and the homeless shelter. Welsh-speaking volunteers welcome.
